correction: No adjudication of German §6a or five-year conditions is established. The actual ruling concerns a defined capital-contribution transaction under Directive 2008/7, not an exemption for every group reorganisation.
effect: Unresolved: this could be an over-specific description of the holding, or the author’s application of its principle to German law.
materiality: Potentially minor source-description overstatement; no established error in the substantive legal reform request.
limits: Paragraphs55–61reject the German government’s economic-ownership argument and explain that it would undermine removing restructuring obstacles. This affirmatively supports a benign analogy reading. No conclusion is drawn that §6a is valid or invalid, or that broader relief is unwarranted.
alternative_explanations: The wording says the judgment confirmed an obstacle, not explicitly that it invalidated §6a. It can therefore express the author’s doctrinal inference rather than a claimed German-law ruling.
reading_extent: All 13 author pages and all 71 judgment paragraphs read, including the German-government arguments and the operative ruling.
